issue_context.title: [Bug]: "Interface Duplex State" should have a dimension per state
issue_context.body:
### Bug description

We encode an interface duplex state as a number, as a result, we have the following problems:
 - have to add a "State map" to dashboard info:
   > "State map: 0 - unknown, 1 - half, 2 - full."`
 - any grouping method **makes no sense** (`average`, `sum`, `min`, `max`). We use `average` when zooming out using the local dashboard, and `sum` on the Cloud overview page.

### Expected behavior

The "Interface Duplex State" should have 3 dimensions:
- unknown
- half
- full


The value is either 0 or 1.

### Steps to reproduce

Check the "Interface Duplex State" chart on the Cloud overview page.



### Installation method

kickstart.sh

### System info

```shell
n/a
```


### Netdata build info

```shell
netdata v1.35.0-17-gf383e5764
```


### Additional info

_No response_
